crossRefs.note: Joshua turned back at that time, and took Hazor, and struck its king with the sword: for Hazor used to be the head of…
the king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;
Yahweh sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan, who reigned in Hazor; the captain of whose army was Sisera, who…
However Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite; for there was peace between…
Therefore Adoni-Zedek king of Jerusalem sent to Hoham king of Hebron, Piram king of Jarmuth, Japhia king of Lachish…
“Come up to me and help me. Let’s strike Gibeon; for they have made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel.”
Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.
Yahweh, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people, and be disappointed.…
When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk…
Don’t be afraid, for I am with you. I will bring your offspring from the east, and gather you from the west.

people.name: Achshaph
people.line: A Canaanite city-state conquered by Joshua.

people.name: Hazor
people.line: Major Canaanite city conquered by Joshua

people.name: Jabin
people.line: King of Hazor; led Canaanite coalition against Joshua.

people.name: Jobab
people.line: King of Madon, who joined forces against Joshua

people.name: Madon
people.line: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua

people.name: Shimron
people.line: Canaanite city conquered by Joshua, allotted to Zebulun

translations.web: When Jabin king of Hazor heard of it, he sent to Jobab king of Madon, to the king of Shimron, to the king of Achshaph,
translations.bsb: Now when Jabin king of Hazor heard about these things, he sent word to Jobab king of Madon; to the kings of Shimron and Achshaph;
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when Jabin king of Hazor heard thereof, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,
